raw_model_deviations.explanation: 通話の一部を人間が担当した事実に、通話中にその声が人間だと明らかになったという具体的な出来事を追加しています。原文にも同じ描写があり、翻訳時に生じた逸脱ではありません。
violation_spans: We Thought It Was AI—But There Was a Person Inside Meta’s Muse
A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person.
Meta had run a test that caused exactly this surprise.
It was like someone took off an AI costume. Then a person stepped out.
